preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases has a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in the strings s is a lowercase letter (a-z).

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(self_similarity(test_cases[i])) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line corresponds to the self-similarity of the corresponding input string.
